Body.Content:
The Azure Insights NuGet package allows you to programmatically retrieve the logs that are exposed in the Azure Preview Portal. This allows you to get the Event Logs for a:
  • Resource
  • Resource group
  • Resource provider
  • Azure subscription
For more information, see Microsoft Azure Insights Library 0.7.1-preview. Also see this code sample for more details: Programmatic Retrieval of Azure Event Logs.
